verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://www.sketch.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of Sketch docs, and an llms-full.txt also exists with full doc content. An agent can be pointed directly at either file. Missing for 10: per-page markdown doc variants (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), and any first-party documentation explaining or promoting the llms.txt files for agent use.
